anomalies.observed: The display SCL pull-up resistor R6 is populated with a 10 MΩ value between DISP_SCL and VCC.
anomalies.expected: The specification states that R6 is a 10 kΩ pull-up on DISP_SCL to VCC, matching the other I2C/open-drain pull-ups on the board.

evidence.quote: DISP_SCL: U2 pin 34 (PB13) — R6 (10 kΩ) to VCC — U4 pin 18 (D0)

anomalies.impact: A 10 MΩ pull-up is far too weak for an I2C-style SCL line. The SCL rising edges will be extremely slow relative to the intended 10 kΩ pull-up, making display communication marginal or non-functional.

parsed.summary: An anomaly is present: R6 is a 10 MΩ pull-up on DISP_SCL instead of the specified 10 kΩ pull-up, which would likely prevent reliable I2C communication with the OLED display. The remaining checked connectivity and component values match the specification.
